sounds.title: Long á: pas and pás
sounds.rule: Vowel length changes the word. pas is a passport; pás is a belt or a strip. Hold the á about twice as long as the a.
sounds.bridge: Estonian also tells words apart by vowel length, so this is a contrast your ear has already met.

sounds.title: Long á: rad and rád
sounds.rule: rad is a row, a queue or a turn. rád is glad, or with mať to like. The á makes the difference.
sounds.bridge: Estonian also tells words apart by vowel length, so this is a contrast your ear has already met.
